description.narrative: (Barbados and Eastern Caribbean): MELSA provides demand-driven, flexible monitoring, evaluation and learning services: performance and impact evaluations, performance monitoring, assessments and surveys (baseline), knowledge management and capacity building, communications, and collaboration, learning, and adaptation (CLA) and support services. The interventions are in full alignment with the Mission's performance management plan with guidance of the Agency's Automated Directives System 201 and USAID's Evaluation Policy. ..MELSA supports the design and implementation of learning events which demonstrate a commitment to achieving Agency priorities within the region, offering expert analyses to improve the quality and impact of programming in the Eastern and Southern Caribbean. In addition, the hallmark of the learning and collaboration events are being tailored to inform more adaptive management at the Mission, thereby encouraging responsiveness to new learning to better address development challenges in the region...MELSA increases the monitoring, evaluation, and learning capacity of new and existing implementing partners, USAID staff, and local organizations. This knowledge sharing and capacity building is intended to promote a partners' abilities to sustain the development outcomes whilst strengthening local organizations....
